name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Communications, he initially worked in the corporate sector. However, a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited his passion for the sport. He volunteered his PR skills, quickly proving his worth with his sharp communication skills and dedication.

At Hitech Development, Ahmad is known for his meticulous approach to crafting narratives that resonate with both fans and sponsors. He believes in transparency and building genuine relationships with the media. His ability to blend technical details with engaging storytelling sets him apart, making complex topics accessible to a wider audience. Ahmad's loyalty and commitment make him a valuable asset to the team, ensuring their message is always clear and impactful.

He is dedicated to building strong relationships between the team and external parties, ensuring that the team's values and achievements are properly conveyed to the public. With a keen eye for detail and a knack for crafting compelling narratives, Ahmad excels at managing the team's image and reputation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left side
physical.description: Ahmad has a warm smile and a confident demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a collection of miniature race cars on his desk.
Insists on starting every press release with a motivational quote.
